title: माध्यमिक तहका कथाहरूमा कोशीय संसक्ति Madhyamik Tahaka Kathaharuma Koshiya Samshakti
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख आख्यानात्मक विधाअन्तर्गत पर्ने कथा विधामा प्रयुक्त कोशीय संसक्तिको अध्ययन विश्लेषणमा आधारित रहेको छ । वस्तुतः यसअन्तर्गत माध्यमिक तह (कक्षा नौ र दश) मा समाविष्टकथाहरूमा प्रयुक्त कोशीय संसक्ति र यसअन्तर्गतका विविध भेदहरूकोे सूक्ष्म समीक्षण गरिएकोछ । यस अध्ययनमा मूलतः भाषावैज्ञानिक ह्यालिडे र हड्सनद्वारा प्रस्तुत संसक्तिसम्बन्धी सैद्धान्तिकअवधारणालाई अध्ययनको आधारका रूपमा लिइएको छ । यस क्रममा पुनरुक्ति र सन्निधानजस्ताकोशीय संसक्तिको अध्ययन गरिएको छ, जसमध्ये पुनरुक्तिअन्तर्गत  पुनरावृत्ति, पर्यायवाची, विपरीतार्थी,समावेशी–समावेश्य र अङ्गी–अङ्गको पहिचान र विश्लेषण गरिएको छ भने सन्निधानअन्तर्गत भाषिकशब्दहरूका बिच सान्निध्य सम्बन्ध स्थापित गर्ने कोशीय सिक्रीहरूको सूक्ष्म अन्वेषण गरिएको छ ।यस क्रममा माध्यमिक तहका कथा विधामा प्रयुक्त कोशीय संसक्तिको स्थिति, विशेषता र पाठरचनामातिनले खेलेको भूमिका अध्ययनलाई विशेष जोड दिइएको छ । प्रस्तुत अध्ययनमा मिश्रित अनुसन्धानविधि (परिमाणात्मक र गुणात्मक) को अवलम्बन गरिएको छ । यस अध्ययनबाट आख्यानात्मक सङ्कथन वा रचनामा प्रयोग हुने कोशीय संसक्ति र तिनको भूमिकाबारे जानकारी प्राप्त गर्न मद्दत पुग्नेअपेक्षा गरिएको छ ।
american_english: This article is based on the study and analysis of lexical cohesion used in the story genre under the narrative genre. In fact, under this, a meticulous examination has been made of the lexical cohesion and its various subcategories used in the stories included at the secondary level (grades nine and ten). In this study, basically the theoretical concept of cohesion presented by linguists Halliday and Hasan has been taken as the foundation of the study. In this course, lexical cohesion such as reiteration and collocation has been studied, among which repetition, synonym, antonym, hyponymy, and meronymy have been identified and analyzed under reiteration, while under collocation, a close investigation has been conducted of lexical chains that establish proximity relationships between linguistic words. In this process, special emphasis has been placed on studying the status, characteristics, and role played in text structure by lexical cohesion used in the secondary-level story genre. In the present study, a mixed research method (quantitative and qualitative) has been adopted. It is expected that this study will help in gaining knowledge about lexical cohesion used in narrative discourse or composition and its role.

informal_english: This paper is based on studying and analyzing lexical cohesion used in the story genre under narrative writing. Basically, under this, a close squiz has been taken at the lexical cohesion and its different varieties used in the stories included at the secondary level (years nine and ten). In this study, the theoretical concept of cohesion put forward by linguists Halliday and Hasan has been taken as the bedrock of the study. Along the way, lexical cohesion such as reiteration and collocation has been studied, where repetition, synonyms, antonyms, hyponymy, and meronymy have been identified and analysed under reiteration, while under collocation, lexical chains establishing proximity relationships between linguistic words get closely investigated. In this process, special focus has been placed on checking out the status, characteristics, and role played in text structure by lexical cohesion used in secondary-level stories. In the present study, a mixed research method (quantitative and qualitative) has been adopted. It is expected that this study will help folks get good insight into lexical cohesion used in narrative discourse or composition and its role.
translator_notes: Preserved strict 7-sentence order. Halliday and Hasan is cited as 'ह्यालिडे र हड्सन' in source Nepali and glossed as Halliday and Hasan [Hudson]. Australian casual style used for informal_english.
